description: This source file contains unit tests for the event-sourced chat grain functionality, including post creation, editing, deletion, and truncation, using the Xunit testing framework.

classes.name: ChatGrainTests
classes.description: Test suite for chat grain functionalities including initialization, posting, editing, deleting, and truncating chat messages.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes a new chat and verifies its default structure contains creation info and empty posts.

methods.name: PostThenDelete
methods.description: Posts a message with a specific GUID and then deletes it, verifying the post presence before and after deletion.

methods.name: PostThenEdit
methods.description: Posts multiple messages, then edits one of them, verifying post count and content update.

methods.name: Truncate
methods.description: Posts more than maximum allowed, then verifies that chat content is truncated to maximum number of posts.
